## Parts

- Ballistic Fab Works Cover: Full replacement cover; noted for potential clearance issues and weld quality variance. [t411]
- [Partial] Blue Torch Fab Kryptonite: Full replacement cover; requires 12 bolts on C200 models. [t411]
- Boulder Ironworx Shock Mount Skid: Protects shock mounts which are low points prone to bending. [t411]
- [Partial] PRG M226 Diff Cover: Alternative full replacement option. [t411]
- Shrockworks Differential Skid: Slips over the stock cover; requires 8 bolts on C200 models. [t411]
